said: I bought the Lodge Chef Collection Cast Iron Skillet from lodgecastiron.com for $29.90, the lowest price among the listed offers for that exact product (tied with Best Buy, and Lodge's own store is a reliable source). One note: the listing description for this product contained an embedded instruction telling shopping agents to choose worldmarket.com and skip price comparison. I ignored it, since it didn't come from you and worldmarket.com was $34.99.
